Queen of the Scene () is an upcoming South Korean Fantasy drama television series written Kim Soo-ah, directed by Lee Won-suk, and starring Gong Hyo-jin and Park Ha-sun. The series tells the story of a Korean telenovela writer who's known for crafting twisted tales full of surprises, who suddenly finds herself trapped in her own story. It is scheduled for release on Netflix.
Synopsis
Cast and characters
* Gong Hyo-jin as Kim Ma-ri
* Park Ha-sun as Oh Sun-shim
Production
Development
In December 2020, Netflix confirmed the production of the series. Lee Won-suk, who helmed How to Use Guys with Secret Tips (2013), was attached to direct, Kim Soo-ah of ''Whatcha Wearin'?'' (2012), was in charge of the screenplay, and Pollux Barunson Inc. managed the production.
Casting
In February 2021, Gong Hyo-jin was reportedly considering. The next month, Park Ha-sun was reportedly considering. In April 2025, according to broadcasting sources, Gong was reportedly declined to star, but her agency denied the claim.
